units.meaning: Under general implementation specifications, a valid authorization is defined as a document that satisfies the applicable requirements set forth in paragraphs (a)(3)(ii), (a)(4)(ii), (c)(1), and (c)(2) of this section.

source_spans.quote: A valid authorization is a document that meets the requirements in paragraphs (a)(3)(ii), (a)(4)(ii), (c)(1), and (c)(2) of this section, as applicable.
(b) Implementation specifications: General requirements—(1) Valid authorizations.

units.meaning: A valid authorization is permitted to include elements or information beyond what is required by this section, conditioned upon those additional elements or information not being inconsistent with the required elements.

source_spans.quote: A valid authorization may contain elements or information in addition to the elements required by this section, provided that such additional elements or information are not inconsistent with the elements required by this section.
(b) Implementation specifications: General requirements—(1) Valid authorizations.

units.meaning: An authorization document is rendered invalid if it contains any one or more of the defects specified in paragraphs (b)(2)(i) through (v).

units.meaning: An authorization is invalid if it has not been filled out completely regarding any applicable element described in paragraph (c) of this section.
